player.title: Meditative+ balance changes II
balance: Arch Mage is 4/8, up from 4/7, and 8/16 on its Radiant face, up from 8/14.
Appropriations gives +(2X−1) Attack, 2X−1 Books, a 7X% chance or +(2X−1) Health, down from +2X, 2X, 8X% and +2X.
Appropriations' Radiant face gives +(4X−2) Attack, 4X Books, a 17X% chance or +5X Health, down from +4X, 5X, 20X% and +6X.
In Too Deep's quests need 4 permanents, 15 damage and totals of 13, up from 3, 12 and 10.
changes: KY's Papaya always Discovers 4 cells, each from 2 random cells (3 on its Radiant face), and destroys the cards on its curve instead of exiling them.
The House's Cry places 3 Plague Counters on it, and its Activate spends one to summon the Right-house defender or Wrong-House Attacker you choose.
Final Gambit cancels the hit instead of redirecting it to the enemy hero.
Fickle E-Kitten asks at the end of your turn instead of the start.
CN in a Bottle's card costs (1) more, up to (4).
